tasks.statement_en: The numbers $x_1=5+\sqrt{23}$ and $x_2=5-\sqrt{23}$ are solutions of the equation $x^2-(p^2+q^2)x+(p+q)=0$ with unknown $x$. Calculate the values of $p$ and $q$.
tasks.notes: Two valid pairs (3,-1) and (-1,3); sum of all four numbers = 3-1-1+3 = 4. [verified: exclude: Two valid pairs. p+q=2 for each pair (Vieta), so a solver may answer 2 (p+q) or 4 (both pairs summed): which-one/all ambiguity.]

tasks.statement_en: From a certain group of people, in which there are twice as many men as women, a two-person delegation is chosen at random. The probability that the delegation consists only of women is equal to $0.1$. Calculate how many women and how many men are in this group.

In a regular quadrilateral pyramid, let $H$ be the height of the pyramid and $\alpha$ the measure of the angle between a lateral edge and a base edge ($45^\circ<\alpha<90^\circ$). a) Show that the volume $V$ of this pyramid equals $\frac{4}{3}\cdot\frac{H^3}{\tan^2\alpha-1}$. b) Calculate the measure of angle $\alpha$ for which the volume $V$ of the given pyramid is equal to $\frac{2}{9}H^3$. Give the result rounded to the nearest whole degree.
tasks.notes: Part a) is a proof (excluded); part b) gives the single numeric answer alpha=69 (tan alpha = sqrt7).

tasks.statement_en: In right triangle $ABC$, the legs have lengths $|BC|=9$ and $|CA|=12$. Point $D$ is chosen on side $AB$ so that segments $BC$ and $CD$ have equal length. Calculate the length of segment $AD$.
